name: Cheing
source:
A mysterious person is going wild in the city!
Unfortunately, the defenders of justice have eaten too much chocolate and have been felled by their stomach-aches.
Enter the W*ng Girls, here to save the day.

Incidentally, the mysterious person has stolen the Dream Notes, and is writing whatever they want on them. What a situation!
The three girls are captured one by one, then subjected to a dirty sort of punishment.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032572.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个神秘人在城里横行！
不幸的是，正义的捍卫者们吃了太多巧克力，被胃痛击垮了。
W*ng Girls登场，拯救世界。

顺便说一句，神秘人偷走了梦笔记，并在上面写下任何他们想要的东西。这是什么情况啊！
三个女孩被一一抓获，然后受到肮脏的惩罚。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032572.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
